one_line: Nvidia's leadership shakeup dominates AI news as funding rounds surge and Tesla launches Cybercab orders.

themes.title: Nvidia faces leadership upheaval
themes.text: Co-founder Jensen Huang resigned as CEO after admitting an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. CFO Colette Kress was named interim CEO, investors urged keeping a return option open, and the board considered Arm CEO Rene Haas as a successor; Nvidia shares fell and concerns were raised about supply‑chain deals and open‑source AI support.

stories.headline: Nvidia approaches Arm CEO Haas as employees seek Huang's return
Nvidia investors urge board to keep Jensen Huang return option open
Nvidia faces leadership transition and market shifts after Jensen Huang's exit
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns as Colette Kress takes over as interim chief
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid scandals, ending an era for Big Tech
Nvidia risks losing supply chain deals without Jensen Huang, warns Elon Musk

themes.title: AI startups receive new capital
themes.text: Databento closed a $100 million Series C round at a $1.1 billion valuation, reporting doubled revenue and contracts with five of six largest frontier AI labs. Nvidia reportedly financed AI startups and cloud providers to absorb excess GPU supply, while cybersecurity startup WhiteMatter raised $20 million Series A to build AI‑agent governance tools.

stories.headline: Databento raises $100M Series C at $1.1B valuation
Nvidia reportedly funded AI startups to absorb excess GPU supply
WhiteMatter raises $20 million Series A for AI agent governance platform

themes.title: Benchmarks reach saturation quickly
themes.text: Ethan Mollick launched SatBench, a tool that tracks how fast major AI benchmarks become saturated, finding that 63 % of 173 benchmarks cited since 2023 are now saturated.

stories.headline: Ethan Mollick creates SatBench to track AI benchmark saturation

themes.title: Tesla opens Cybercab orders
themes.text: Tesla offered select customers the chance to order its driverless Cybercab for personal use at $29,990, requiring a $299 per month autonomy subscription and limited to service areas in Texas and Florida.

stories.headline: Tesla invites select customers to order Cybercab for personal use
